note: Links to published reporting on West Bengal OBC policy and litigation. Summaries are the archive's own short descriptions; read the original article and the court record before citing.

items.author: Srinjoy Das
items.headline: Calcutta High Court Cancels OBC Certificates Issued In West Bengal After 2010, Scraps OBC Classification Of 77 Communities
items.summary: Reports the Division Bench judgment in WPO 60 of 2011 setting aside OBC certificates issued from 2010, about 5 lakh in number, while protecting people already employed.

items.headline: Explained | Why did Calcutta HC cancel OBC certificates issued since 2010?
items.summary: Explains the reasoning of the 22 May 2024 judgment and who is affected.

items.author: PTI
items.headline: West Bengal govt seeks SC stay on HC verdict striking down OBC status of several castes
items.summary: The State asks the Supreme Court for an urgent stay, citing NEET-UG 2024 admissions; the Court lists the matter for 27 August.

items.author: IANS
items.headline: SC to hear pleas challenging cancellation of OBC certificates in Bengal on Sept 2
items.summary: The Supreme Court defers the hearing on the batch of appeals by a week at the State's request.

items.author: PTI
items.headline: West Bengal OBC case: Reservation can't be on basis of religion, says SC
items.summary: During the hearing the Supreme Court observes that religion cannot be the basis for reservation; the State says its criteria rest on backwardness. Detailed arguments set for 7 January 2025.

items.author: Debby Jain
items.headline: West Bengal OBC Classification Issue: State Commission Conducting Fresh Exercise To Identify Backward Classes; Supreme Court Posts Matter To July
items.summary: The State tells Justices B.R. Gavai and A.G. Masih that the Commission is redoing the identification exercise; the appeals are posted to July.

items.headline: Calcutta High Court stays implementation of West Bengal's new OBC list
items.summary: The High Court pauses the State's revised list of 140 classes in Amal Chandra Das v. State of West Bengal.

items.headline: New OBC list: State seeks urgent hearing in SC over Cal HC stay
items.summary: The State seeks an urgent Supreme Court hearing against the 17 June 2025 High Court stay.

items.author: LiveLaw News Network
items.headline: West Bengal Govt Approaches Supreme Court Challenging Calcutta HC Staying New OBC List Notification
items.summary: Senior Advocate Kapil Sibal seeks urgent listing of the State's challenge to the 17 June 2025 stay.

items.author: Anmol Kaur Bawa
items.headline: 'Surprising, Erroneous': Supreme Court Stays Calcutta HC Order Which Stayed New OBC List In West Bengal
items.summary: A bench led by CJI B.R. Gavai stays the High Court's 17 June order in State of West Bengal v. Purabi Das, SLP(C) 17422 of 2025, calling it prima facie erroneous.

items.author: Anu Parthiban
items.headline: Calcutta HC orders fresh WBJEE merit list 2025 within 15 days, 7% reservation for 66 classes of OBC
items.summary: Justice Kausik Chanda directs a new WBJEE 2025 merit list applying 7% reservation for the 66 pre-2010 classes.

items.author: PTI
items.headline: Cal HC orders WBJEE Board to publish new merit list
items.summary: Justice Kausik Chanda finds the WBJEE 2025 merit list breached the 21 May order and directs a fresh list within 15 days.

items.author: Anmol Kaur Bawa
items.headline: Supreme Court Stays Calcutta HC Direction To Recast WBJEB Results As Per Pre-2010 OBC Reservation
items.summary: CJI B.R. Gavai and Justice K. Vinod Chandran stay the 7 August direction in State of West Bengal v. X, Diary 45628 of 2025.

items.author: Debayan Roy
items.headline: Supreme Court stays Calcutta HC order on WBJEE merit list; paves way for applying new quota policy
items.summary: The stay lets WBJEE 2025 results be declared under the State's June 2025 policy.

items.author: Scroll Staff
items.headline: Supreme Court stays proceedings in Calcutta HC on preparation of new West Bengal OBC list
items.summary: The Supreme Court tells the High Court not to proceed with the new-list matter while the appeals are pending before it.

items.author: PTI
items.headline: Cal HC seeks reasoned order on plea against accepting invalid OBC certificates in SIR
items.summary: The High Court asks the Chief Electoral Officer to decide within a week whether certificates struck down in 2024 may be used in the electoral roll revision.

items.headline: Calcutta High Court Asks EC To Decide On Use Of Invalid OBC Certificates In Electoral Roll Revision
items.summary: Justice Krishna Rao directs the CEO to decide within a week on a voter's representation.

items.headline: Invalid OBC certificates barred from use in SIR hearings: EC
items.summary: The Chief Electoral Officer tells district officers not to accept OBC certificates voided by the High Court during the roll revision.

items.headline: West Bengal reduces OBC reservation to 7%, 66 castes regularised in big revision of quota list
items.summary: Reports the May 2026 revision that reduces OBC reservation to 7% for 66 classes.

items.headline: West Bengal government notifies list of 66 OBC classes following Calcutta High Court order
items.summary: The State notifies 66 classes with a single 7% reservation, dropping the OBC-A (10%) and OBC-B (7%) split.

items.author: Himanshi Hans
items.headline: West Bengal Assembly Passes OBC Amendment Bills, Removes 77 Muslim Communities From List
items.summary: The Assembly passes the 2026 amendments to the reservation and Commission Acts, setting a single 7% quota for 66 classes.

items.author: Amisha Shrivastava
items.headline: West Bengal Withdraws Appeal In Supreme Court Against Calcutta HC Verdict Striking Down OBC Status For 77 Communities
items.summary: A bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana allows the State and the Commission to withdraw; other aggrieved parties may still challenge the 2024 judgment.

items.headline: WB govt withdraws appeal in SC against Calcutta HC verdict striking down OBC status for 77 communities
items.summary: Public broadcaster's report of the 14 July 2026 withdrawal.

items.headline: Calcutta HC cancels all OBC certificates issued under revised rules by previous state govt
items.summary: Reports the 12 August 2026 Division Bench judgment voiding certificates issued under the 2025 notifications.

items.headline: Calcutta High Court Revives Stay On 114 OBC Classes After West Bengal Government Withdraws Supreme Court Appeals
items.summary: Justices Rajasekhar Mantha and Anuj Singh record that the June 2025 stay is revived and invalidate an April 2026 OBC-A certificate.

items.author: Srinjoy Das
items.headline: NEET-UG 2026: Candidates Can't Claim EWS Reservation After Declaration Of Results: Calcutta High Court
items.summary: Justice Amrita Sinha dismisses WPA 21501 of 2026.

items.author: Srinjoy Das
items.headline: 'OBC-A Category Struck Down': Calcutta High Court Denies Relief To SLST Aspirants Seeking Reservation Benefits
items.summary: Justice Aniruddha Roy dismisses WPA 23207 and 23209 of 2026.

items.author: LiveLaw News Network
items.headline: Supreme Court Issues Notice On Plea Challenging Calcutta HC Judgment Invalidating Bengal OBC Certificates Issued In 2025-2026
items.summary: Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana issue notice in Diary 50605 and 41300 of 2026; appointments remain subject to the outcome.

items.author: Debayan Roy
items.headline: Supreme Court seeks West Bengal's reply on plea challenging invalidation of OBC certificates issued in 2025-26
items.summary: The Court asks the State to respond to the challenge to the August 2026 judgment.

items.author: Pioneer News Service
items.headline: Supreme Court agrees to hear plea challenging Calcutta HC OBC certificate order
items.summary: Reports that the plea was tagged with a pending case and listed for 23 November.

items.author: Srinjoy Das
items.headline: Calcutta High Court Seeks State's Response On Plea By Former OBC Candidates Seeking EWS Reservation In Teacher Recruitment
items.summary: Justice Arjun Ray Mukherjee calls for affidavits in WPA 31572 of 2026 (Mohabul Islam) on former OBC applicants seeking EWS status.
